name: Hybrid Loss Gradient
definition: Computes gradients by combining a pixel-wise Charbonnier $\ell_1$ term and a tile-level sparse Normalized Cross-Correlation (NCC) term to stabilize sparse optimization.
summary: The Hybrid Loss Gradient stabilizes sparse volume rendering training by combining pixel-wise photometric and tile-level structural NCC terms, maintaining gradient alignment with the full objective through importance sampling.
